facts.fact: According to Zendesk's lead magnet overview, 50% of marketers report higher conversion rates when they use lead magnets as part of early-stage acquisition strategy, compared with generic contact or subscribe forms.
facts.quote: 50% of marketers report higher conversion rates when they use lead magnets as part of their early-stage acquisition strategy, compared with generic contact or subscribe forms

facts.fact: According to Showit's lead magnet guide, problem-specific lead magnets achieve 30 to 50% higher opt-in conversion rates compared with generic "top-10" guides.
facts.quote: problem-specific lead magnets achieve 30 to 50% higher opt-in conversion rates compared with generic “top-10” guides

facts.fact: According to MailerLite's lead magnet statistics, simple form-based landing pages designed around a single lead magnet converted at 24.44%.
facts.quote: simple form-based landing pages designed around a single lead magnet converted at 24.44%, while generic pop-up forms yielded about 8.96%

facts.fact: According to MailerLite's lead magnet statistics, generic pop-up forms yielded about 8.96% conversion.
According to MailerLite's lead magnet statistics, visitors were roughly 2.7 times more likely to submit their information on a focused single-magnet landing page.
facts.quote: Visitors were **roughly 2.7 times more likely** to submit their information on a focused page.

facts.fact: According to Wit & Wire's lead magnet funnel guide, a minimal three-step funnel of landing page, single-field opt-in form, and instant delivery typically achieves 20 to 40% higher list-growth rates.
facts.quote: a minimal, three-step funnel of landing page, single-field opt-in form, and instant delivery typically achieves 20 to 40% higher list-growth rates

facts.fact: According to Wit & Wire's lead magnet funnel guide, high-performing SMB funnels commonly see 15 to 25% conversion rates when the magnet is tied to a clear pain point.
facts.quote: high-performing funnels for SMBs commonly see 15 to 25% conversion rates when the magnet is tied to a clear pain point

facts.fact: The Adwave page recommends a welcome sequence of three emails: delivering the resource, helping the subscriber use it, and bridging to the next step.
facts.quote: A simple three-email sequence is enough.
